en: Between 1908 and 1924, Gwendoline and Margaret Davies amassed one of the largest collections of late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century French paintings in Britain.
uz: 1908-yildan 1924-yilgacha Gvendolin va Margaret Deyvis Britaniyadagi XIX asr oxiri va XX asr boshlariga oid frantsuz rasmlarining eng yirik to'plamlaridan birini yig'ishdi.
structure: Time phrase + Subject + Verb + Object. The long “of …” string only says which collection — strip it out and the frame is simply “they amassed one of the largest collections”.

chunks.en: of late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century French paintings
chunks.uz: XIX asr oxiri va XX asr boshlariga oid frantsuz rasmlarining

en: Their religious upbringing in rural Wales gave them a deep sense of social responsibility and they chose to use their inheritance for cultural and philanthropic purposes.
uz: Uels qishloqlarida diniy tarbiya olganliklari ularga chuqur ijtimoiy mas'uliyat tuyg'usini berdi va ular o'z merosini madaniy hamda xayriya maqsadlarida ishlatishni tanladilar.
structure: Two clauses joined by “and”. In the first, the subject is a thing, not a person (“upbringing gave them…”) — Uzbek turns it into “olgan tarbiyalari ularga … berdi”.

chunks.en: Their religious upbringing in rural Wales
a deep sense of social responsibility
and they chose to use their inheritance

en: While it was long assumed that these men were largely responsible for the nature of the sisters' collection, it has recently been accepted that Gwendoline and Margaret retained a far more active role in the process.
uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida bu erkaklar opa-singillar to'plamining mohiyati uchun asosan javobgar deb hisoblab kelingan bo'lsa-da, yaqinda Gvendolin va Margaret bu jarayonda ancha faolroq rol o'ynaganligi e'tirof etildi.
structure: Two “it + passive + that” frames. “It” is a dummy — the real subject is each that-clause. Read it as “people long assumed X … but it is now accepted that Y”.

chunks.uz: uzoq vaqt shunday deb hisoblab kelingan

chunks.en: these men were largely responsible for the nature of the sisters' collection,
chunks.uz: bu erkaklar opa-singillar to'plamining mohiyati uchun asosan javobgar edi

chunks.en: it has recently been accepted that
Gwendoline and Margaret retained a far more active role
chunks.uz: Gvendolin va Margaret ancha faolroq rolni saqlab qolgan

en: Quite simply, high quality Old Master works were, if not beyond their means, then beyond what they were willing to pay for them.
uz: Oddiy qilib aytganda, yuqori sifatli “Eski ustalar” asarlari ularning imkoniyatidan tashqarida bo'lmasa ham, ular to'lashga tayyor bo'lgan narxdan qimmatroq edi.
structure: The frame is “X was, if not A, then B” — “maybe not A, but certainly B”. Both A and B start with “beyond”, so the comparison is about price.

chunks.en: then beyond what they were willing to pay for them.
chunks.uz: ular to'lashga tayyor bo'lgan narxdan qimmat edi

en: However, it was only a few years before their collecting took a new direction and they turned to the work of the French Impressionists.
uz: Biroq, bir necha yil o'tar-o'tmas ularning to'plash faoliyati yangi yo'nalish oldi va ular frantsuz impressionistlari ijodiga yuzlandilar.
structure: “It was only a few years before X” = “only a few years later, X happened” — the “it” says nothing, the time span does.

chunks.en: it was only a few years before
chunks.role: Time frame — “only a few years later”

chunks.en: their collecting took a new direction
chunks.uz: ularning to'plash faoliyati yangi yo'nalish oldi

chunks.en: and they turned to the work of the French Impressionists.
chunks.uz: va ular frantsuz impressionistlari ijodiga yuzlandilar

en: Their initial response to the war effort was to finance the safe passage of artists from occupied Belgium to Wales, as a humanitarian act, but also with the hope of establishing a vibrant artists' community in the area.
uz: Urushga bo'lgan dastlabki munosabatlari — insonparvarlik ishi sifatida, shuningdek hududda jonli rassomlar jamoasini barpo etish umidida — bosib olingan Belgiyadan Uelsga rassomlarning xavfsiz ko'chib o'tishini moliyalashtirish bo'ldi.
structure: “Their response was to finance …” — subject + be + to-infinitive. Everything after it is one long purpose tail: “as …, but also with the hope of …”.

chunks.en: Their initial response to the war effort
to finance the safe passage of artists
but also with the hope of establishing a vibrant artists' community in the area.
chunks.uz: shuningdek hududda jonli rassomlar jamoasini barpo etish umidida

en: It was tedious and distressing work, which would have a permanent effect on Gwendoline's health.
uz: Bu zerikarli va iztirobli ish bo'lib, keyinchalik Gvendolinning sog'lig'iga doimiy ta'sir ko'rsatgan.
structure: A main clause plus a non-defining “which” clause. “Which” points back to the whole work, and “would” here is the past-in-the-future: it went on to have that effect.

chunks.en: It was tedious and distressing work,
chunks.uz: Bu zerikarli va iztirobli ish edi

en: Yet they didn't feel obliged to follow fashionable tastes and were free to pursue their own preferences.
uz: Shunga qaramay, ular urfdagi didlarga ergashishga o'zlarini majbur his qilishmadi va o'z xohishlariga amal qilishda erkin edilar.
structure: Two predicates share one subject: “they didn't feel obliged … and (they) were free …”. “Yet” marks the contrast with the previous sentence.

chunks.en: they didn't feel obliged to follow fashionable tastes
chunks.uz: ular urfdagi didlarga ergashishga majbur his qilishmadi

chunks.en: were free to pursue their own preferences.
chunks.uz: o'z xohishlariga amal qilishda erkin edilar

en: By the early 1920s, Gwendoline felt increasingly uncomfortable buying art works when faced with the poverty and social upheaval created by the First World War.
uz: 1920-yillarning boshlariga kelib, Birinchi jahon urushi keltirib chiqargan qashshoqlik va ijtimoiy larzalar oldida Gvendolin san'at asarlarini sotib olishdan tobora noqulaylik his qila boshladi.
structure: “Felt uncomfortable buying” — feel + adjective + -ing. The tail is a reduced clause: “when (she was) faced with … (that was) created by …”.

chunks.en: when faced with the poverty and social upheaval
chunks.role: Reduced clause — “when she was faced with”
chunks.uz: qashshoqlik va ijtimoiy larzalar bilan yuzma-yuz kelganda

chunks.en: created by the First World War.
chunks.role: Reduced relative — “that had been created by”

en: The sisters collected French Impressionist paintings at a time when such art was routinely ignored by individuals and institutions alike.
uz: Opa-singillar frantsuz impressionizmi rasmlarini bunday san'at ham oddiy odamlar, ham muassasalar tomonidan odatda e'tiborsiz qoldirilgan bir paytda yig'ishdi.
structure: “At a time when …” opens a whole background clause, and that clause is passive: the art was ignored (by whom is said at the end).

chunks.role: Time frame — “in an era in which”

chunks.uz: ham oddiy odamlar, ham muassasalar tomonidan barobar

en: There are usually about eight people but no more than ten, and everyone's always very friendly.
uz: Odatda sakkizga yaqin, lekin o'ndan ko'p bo'lmagan odam bo'ladi va hamma doim juda samimiy.
structure: “There are …” states existence, not location. “no more than ten” caps the number, and “everyone's” = “everyone is”.

chunks.en: There are usually about eight people

en: You learn about things like the weather, which is obviously really important.
uz: Siz ob-havo kabi narsalarni o'rganasiz, bu esa, shubhasiz, juda muhim.
structure: The “which” does not refer to “the weather” but to the whole idea of learning about it — a comment on the previous clause.

chunks.en: You learn about things like the weather,
